content.text: Selling a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-2|The Complete]]s. But for millions of creators, the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-works-how-2|payment]] layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-digital-products-africa-guide-leaves-2|COREMERCH guide to everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

The landscape of digital commerce has shifted as creators seek autonomy from restrictive payment platforms. Solana payments stand out for their low fees and fast transaction times, providing a sustainable model for selling digital products. In contrast to platforms like Gumroad, which charges up to 10% on every sale, NOWPayments offers a significantly lower fee of just 0.5%. This difference can retain substantial income for creators, particularly when selling high-demand products, ensuring they keep more of their hard-earned revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, Solana payment processing integrates seamlessly with an infrastructure stack designed for sovereignty. The architecture comprises components like Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Google Drive for product delivery, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This setup not only circumvents traditional payment barriers but also automates processes such as payment confirmation and product delivery. As a result, every transaction is efficient, cost-effective, and entirely under the creator's control, allowing them to focus on their craft without the constant worry of platform fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment solution is tailored for digital creators in regions where conventional payment systems are inaccessible. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates, the sovereignty offered by Solana payments empowers you to operate independently. This system is particularly beneficial for creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, who have faced significant challenges with currency instability and financial exclusion. By utilizing this robust infrastructure, you can build a reliable income stream with minimal friction.
Retain more revenue by using NOWPayments with only a 0.5% fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The infrastructure comprises several critical components that work in unison to facilitate digital product sales. Using Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing, creators can set up a powerful online store. Each component is designed to ensure that transactions are smooth and secure. Furthermore, with solutions like Supabase for order management, creators can track customer purchases without worrying about data loss or platform dependence.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start utilizing Solana payments for your digital products, first identify your product and prepare it for sale. Next, set up a hosting solution like Cloudflare Pages to create your storefront. Implement Google Apps Script for backend logic to handle transactions and orders. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Finally, ensure your product delivery mechanism is ready, using Google Drive or similar services. This streamlined approach allows you to launch your digital store quickly and effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a cryptocurrency payment processor like NOWPayments. This allows you to bypass traditional payment barriers and retain more of your sales revenue due to lower fees. For example, with 100 sales of a $97 product, the fee difference between NOWPayments and Gumroad retains $921 in your pocket.
Take full ownership of your digital store and customer data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in maximizing your digital sales potential, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This product contains all six blueprints and seven templates necessary for building and deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
